concepts.gloss_en: The subduing/being-subdued of the luminaries of fire (a state brought about by mourning the Temple)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are the identical phrase נכנעין מאורי אש in the same paragraph and sentence of lm2:67, describing the same idea — that mourning the Temple causes the luminaries of fire to be subdued. Same word, same sense, no homograph issue.
